description: Fingerprints of the tested Windows x86 PD2/D2GL files and plugin, with activation and loader settings.
validation: All three Win32 Release suites pass with local artwork/tables and private archive fixtures. The user confirmed the installed hardcoded 31-subtile build works; live campaign logs confirm mode=hardcoded and radiusSubtiles=31.00. Ships that exact user-tested DLL. Old distance INI values are ignored, including oversized values; color/style/opacity preferences remain available. Broader compatibility and long-session performance remain under test; this is not online approval or anti-tamper enforcement.
gameTables: Automatically read from active installed game archives or direct overrides via native Storm; the development fixture hashes are informational, not files to download. Missing or malformed tables retain native/per-area fallback.
optionalMenuNote: The native Boundary Color menu row requires the profiled expansion menu. A different menu layout leaves INI color selection available; this optional fingerprint does not replace runtime layout guards.
